title: Cassandre Beaugard Breaks French 5km Road Record in Monaco
text:
Cassandre Beaugrand : A French⁤ Triathlon Star Makes Waves on the Road Even ⁢after a​ grueling swim⁤ session the day before, Olympic champion Cassandre Beaugrand was ready to push her limits. This past ‍Sunday, in the streets of Monaco,⁤ she participated in ⁢her first-ever 5km road‍ race, a surprising turn for a triathlete known for her prowess ⁤in swimming, cycling, and running.
“Even when the goal is being tested for the first time having fun and despite a large swimming session the day before, the Olympic champion Cassandre Beaugrand continues to​ perform,” ‍a recent article noted.⁤
Beaugrand’s performance was nothing short of notable. though she finished‌ fourth in the race, won by Ethiopian⁣ runner Likina Amebaw with a time of 14’32”, Beaugrand ‍clocked in at​ 14’53”, shattering the French record‍ previously held by Sara benfares (suspended in 2024 for doping) as 2022.
“His time 14′53 ′ allowed him to improve the French record that Sara Benfares held (suspended in 2024 for doping) from 2022 in 14′58 ”. A performance that still shows that the ⁣race ⁣is the strong⁢ point ⁣of Cassandre Beaugrand.He is really holding the younger French⁢ record of 1,500 m,” the ⁣article stated.
This remarkable ‍feat​ highlights Beaugrand’s versatility and dedication ‌to pushing her athletic boundaries. while ⁤she is best known for her triathlon ⁢achievements, including her current title as the World Triathlon Championship ‌Series (WTCS) champion, this road race performance demonstrates her remarkable running ability and potential for success⁤ in⁤ other disciplines.
A Shift in Focus: Beaugrand’s Upcoming Plans
Following this exciting foray into road racing,Beaugrand will be taking a strategic break from the WTCS circuit. She will skip the first round‌ of the championship in Abu Dhabi next weekend, choosing instead to focus on her track training.
“After this parenthesis, the triathlete who now trains in Girona (Spain) will ignore the first round of ‌the world series of the Triathlon‌ Championship (WTCS), of which he owns the title, next weekend in Abu Dhabi,” the article explained.
Beaugrand will ⁣return to competition at the ‍Liévin Room’s meeting on March 23, where she will likely test her speed on the ‍track.She will then rejoin the WTCS circuit in May, competing in Yokohama, Japan.
The Future of Beaugrand: A⁣ Multi-Disciplinary Athlete
Beaugrand’s decision to explore road racing and prioritize track training⁣ suggests‌ a strategic approach to her athletic progress. By honing her running skills ​on both the track and the road, she is likely aiming to further enhance‍ her triathlon performance.
This multi-disciplinary approach is becoming increasingly common among elite athletes,as they seek to maximize their potential across different disciplines.‌ For example, American runner Molly Seidel, known for her marathon success, has recently competed in shorter road races, demonstrating the benefits of cross-training.
Beaugrand’s story is an inspiring example‍ of an athlete ⁤who is not ⁣afraid to challenge herself and explore new possibilities. her dedication,⁤ versatility, and drive to excel make⁢ her a force to be reckoned with ⁣in⁣ the world‌ of triathlon⁤ and beyond.
